explanation: The battle's lead carries the consequence to its end: taking Tumbledown and the high ground around it "allowed British troops to secure a dominant position over the town, leading to the fall of Stanley and the surrender of Argentine forces on the islands." The surrender is a record this atlas already held; this is the engagement its own article names as what led there. `probable`: one article states the chain, and it is the article of the battle rather than of the surrender, so the claim is the battle's own.
